title: Bash compatibility tests
description: Create comprehensive pytest test suite for bash compatibility layer covering variable expansion, string operations, brace expansion, control flow, commands, test commands, and arithmetic

title: Bash compatibility missing features
description: Implement missing bash features: function definitions, heredocs, process substitution, ANSI-C strings, and various ${var@X} transformations

title: Fix stderr redirect parsing
description: 'echo err >&2' causes 'child index out of range' error. Stderr redirects not working.

title: Fix exit code capture in bash interpreter
description: Running 'false' returns exit_code=0 instead of 1. The $? variable isn't being set correctly after command execution.

title: Bash compatibility bug fixes
description: Fix bugs and flaky behavior discovered during testing. Address TODOs in code including multi-command substitution, array handling, and arithmetic error handling

title: Fix 'exit N' parsing bug
description: 'exit 42' causes 'child index out of range' error. Discovered during test harness development. Once fixed, update test_exit_code in test_harness_smoke.py to use 'exit 42' instead of 'false'.

title: Fix standalone variable assignment bug
description: Variable assignments cause 'Invalid argument' error. Both standalone 'MYVAR=hello' and 'export MYVAR=hello' fail. Discovered during test harness development.

title: Test harness infrastructure
description: Build the test harness for bash compatibility testing: fork-based isolation runner, env reset, BashTest/Check types, comparison logic, pytest integration
close_reason: Test harness complete with run_isolated(), run_bash_reference(), Check types, and initial test suite (16 tests)

title: Fix double-quoted string in echo
description: 'echo "hello world"' outputs empty line instead of 'hello world'. Double-quoted strings not being handled correctly.
